\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=2, transform shape]

\node[obs] (X) {$X$};
\node[obs, right=of X] (Y) {$Y$};
\node[latent, right=of Y] (W) {$W$};
\node[latent, below=of Y] (YS) {$Y_*$};
\node[obs, left=of YS] (XS) {$X_*$};

% Connect the nodes
\edge {X} {Y};
\edge {W} {Y};
\edge {W} {YS};
\edge {XS} {YS};

% Add plate

\end{tikzpicture}
